evidence.description: Traced every REQ-701..707 clause against the orchestrator; default-OFF gating (REQ-701), path-scoped commit idiom (REQ-702), throttle (REQ-704), sync-before-commit (REQ-705), idempotent cursor (REQ-707) all correctly implemented and match spec text.

REQ-706/NFR-Security's 'never publish anything outside ledger.jsonl lines' claim is contradicted by the code's own unscoped `git push origin main` (FIND-001) and its 'verified' claim about index.mjs safeAppend call sites is factually false (FIND-003).

Confirmed all REQ-701..707 named edge cases (exact >=10 lines, exact 15min, zero pending, first-push-no-bypass, commit-fails-after-append, push-fails, sync-fails) each have a dedicated passing test. The push-scope/divergence-recovery edge cases identified during adversarial review (FIND-001/FIND-002/FIND-005) have zero test coverage.
decidePublish/extractWakeId pure-core logic independently traced and confirmed correct against the REQ-704 truth table and REQ-707 ordering (marker write happens before commit attempt, line 184-187).

Traced the SAME shared repo checkout (LOOP_REPO_ROOT) being written to by evolve.mjs's live-wired promote() and read/written/pushed by ledger-publish.mjs -- confirms FIND-001's unscoped-push hazard is real and reachable, not hypothetical.
Confirmed both automaton and Franklin instances default to the SAME ANICCA_REPO checkout on the same host -- confirms FIND-002's cross-instance concurrency hazard is real, not hypothetical.

Single-responsibility ~230-line module, pure/effectful split matches verification-architecture.md's map exactly, clear naming, no dead code, no unnecessary duplication (defaultGit mirrors evolve.mjs's own 3-line git() helper intentionally, per spec's own stated precedent-following, not accidental duplication).
Wiring is minimal and correctly placed OUTSIDE runOneWake() per the purity-boundary map, with its own defense-in-depth try/catch at the call site.
decidePublish/extractWakeId confirmed genuinely pure (no I/O, no imports beyond the redaction util) -- the purity claim for these two functions is accurate.

The Concurrency NFR and PROP-701..710 proof-obligation table have no entry for cross-instance shared-checkout git concurrency (FIND-002) or for divergence-that-never-resolves / cursor-loss-on-recovery (FIND-005) -- both are real, reachable failure modes given this repo's actual multi-instance-same-host deployment topology and are absent from the verification strategy entirely.
